Ahead of the Storm produces portable, auditable tropical cyclone impact reports and alert artifacts. Choose a route by what you need to do or understand.

## Start by Task

- **First run:** complete the [credential-free portable snapshot tutorial](tutorials/first-portable-snapshot.qmd).
- **Perform a task:** use the [development setup](how-to/set-up-development.qmd), [snapshot](how-to/run-a-snapshot.qmd), [Snowflake export](how-to/export-a-snowflake-baseline.qmd), [comparison review](how-to/review-comparison-results.qmd), or [publication](how-to/publish-snapshot-bundles.qmd) guides.
- **Look up a contract:** start with the [CLI](reference/cli.qmd), [Snapshot Output Bundle](reference/snapshot-output-bundle.qmd), or [comparison and certification](reference/comparison-and-certification.qmd) reference.
- **Understand the system:** read the [architecture](explanation/architecture.qmd), [trust model](explanation/portable-report-trust-model.qmd), and [semantic facts and presentation](explanation/semantic-facts-and-presentation.qmd).

## Start by Role

| If you are... | Start here |
|---|---|
| Developing or reviewing the portable flow | [First Portable Snapshot](tutorials/first-portable-snapshot.qmd) |
| Exporting operational source evidence | [Export a Snowflake Baseline](how-to/export-a-snowflake-baseline.qmd) |

## Evidence Boundary

A passing synthetic or wrapper-derived run is provisional. Certification requires independently produced, trusted-current expected output. Alert Presentation Self-Checks verify local claims against local HTML; they do not establish Alert Parity.

Canonical terminology and evidence boundaries are rendered in the [Glossary](reference/glossary.qmd) from the root `CONTEXT.md` source.
